title: Disconnect coolant hoses, A/C lines and heater lines

notices.text: Cap every opened A/C fitting immediately with new O-rings ready for reassembly; moisture in the system means a new receiver/drier. Inspect the plastic coolant distribution pieces and the thermostat housing as they come off — these are the M96's own coolant weak points and they go brittle. Photograph the hose routing around the AOS, it is easy to get wrong on reassembly.

steps.text: Disconnect coolant hoses, A/C lines and heater lines.
